changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationtrack AS SELECT pat.id, pat.pre_authorization_id, pat.track_type, pat.status, pat.outcome, pat.message, pat.disposition, pat.transaction_id, pat.outgoing_transaction_id, pat.approval_request_id, pat.approval_response_id, pat.request_json, pat.response_json, pat.created_date, pat.created_by, pat.last_modified_by, pat.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_track pat;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationtrack TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationtrack FROM report_user;
